newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's EGAT mandates underwriters for bonds.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's EGAT mandates underwriters for bonds.

text.p: The Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) on Friday mandated 10 Thai banks and finance firms to underwrite its eight-year, four-billion- baht unsecured bonds. Som Chatusripitak, president of Siam City Bank Plc, said the underwriters were joint successful bidders for the issue, the third by the state-owned power producer this year.

Other underwriters were Thai Military Bank Plc, Nakornthon Bank Plc, SITCA Investment and Securities Plc, Thanasap Finance and Securities Co Ltd, Siam City Syndicate Finance and Securities Co Ltd, Thai Sakura Finance and Securities Co Ltd, Chao Phaya Finance and Securities Plc, Thai Rung Rueng Finance and Securities Co Ltd, and Thai Farmers Bank Plc.
The bond issue pays semi-annual interest on its 10.1 percent coupon with no put option.
